decisions.decision: Logo height is a per-template ChromeFields field stored on the snapshot
decisions.rationale: Global config would apply one value everywhere and re-render old documents at today's value; a clamp-only fix gave no control. Storing on the snapshot means an existing document keeps the size it was generated with.

decisions.decision: The 05.1 seam test uses 15mm, not the 30mm default
decisions.rationale: At 30mm the pre-fix PDF's hard-coded max-height:3cm coincidentally produces the correct answer, so a default-height assertion would pass against broken code.

decisions.decision: Ticket filtering is scoped to the target release only, never global
decisions.rationale: release_ticket_item_key_unique (release_id, ticket_key) is per-release precisely so a hotfix can ship in two releases. A global filter would make that state unreachable through the UI while leaving it reachable in data.

decisions.decision: The release scope is a separate argument to TicketSearchService.search, not a field on TicketSearchCriteria
decisions.rationale: toJql() then has no access to it — the constraint is enforced by the type system rather than by a comment someone could later ignore.

decisions.decision: A new sibling AddTicketsToReleaseDialog rather than extending AddToReleaseDialog
decisions.rationale: D-03-01 in that component's own header says it owns exactly one job and contains no search or table. The new dialog is its mirror image (release fixed, tickets chosen).

decisions.decision: 05.3 resolves accountId to email at READ time; nothing stored changes
decisions.rationale: The only option of three that fixes already-recorded history — document_snapshot is append-only, so a stored label could never be corrected. Also keeps the stable identifier rather than freezing a mutable one.

decisions.decision: The dashboard is Phase 8, after Phase 7, not a 5.x decimal
decisions.rationale: Only documentation readiness has data today; ladder position and promotion history are Phase 7. Building earlier would show one source and be reworked. It also absorbs AUDIT-04, which no ROADMAP phase was claiming.
